'''October 2000 Kingsport tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Evermore, Kingsport, TN on 14 October 2000. [[Eric Erwin]] won it. It is known from Randy Koruschak's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1347">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-15-kingsport-tn-10-14-00d1347/ kingsport-tn-10-14-00], DeckTech (Randy "the tall guy" Koruschak, 15 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-15-kingsport-tn-10-14-00d1347/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 14 October 2000
* '''Site:''' Evermore, Kingsport, TN
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Eric Erwin]]
